heightRepairs.note: Interpolated deck estimates where the terrain model has no bridge surface; every other sample is the terrain model's own (bilinear) height.
heightRepairs.deckEndBlend: final heights within 12 m of each repaired span's ends use a ±12 m average (vertical curve) instead of ±4 m (84 samples)

meta.heightSmoothing: Centerline height = bilinear DTM sample, then 5-sample (±4 m) moving average along distance. Plan line: OSM nodes resampled at 1 m and smoothed with a ±4 m moving average before resampling at 2 m. Shoulder outer edge = raw bilinear DTM.
notes: Closed loop starting at the first member way of OSM relation 38567; the last cross-section joins the first (seam step 2 m in plan, -0.06 m in height).
Road width 12 m is an assumption (FIA minimum for new permanent circuits); the real width varies along the circuit.
DTM read from the official 1 km DGM1 GeoTIFF tiles (bilinear between 1 m cell centres).
Bridge decks (OSM bridge=yes; the terrain model excludes bridges): road and shoulder height interpolated linearly between the ground at each end, at stations 1647-1695 m, 4921-4967 m.

Unmarked structures (the DGM removes bridges also where the road below carries the tag): road profile pits more than 1 m below the chord over up to 60 m bridged linearly, deck and shoulders, at stations 3949-3981 m, 4917-4959 m.
OSM vs bacinger/f1-circuits de-1927 centerline offset: median 0.4 m, p95 1.9 m, max 32.9 m.
Inside shoulder narrowed to 70% of local turn radius on 12 sections (stations 4115-4131 m, 4683-4687 m) so it does not cross itself; 0 triangles fold over in plan view.
